events.title: Memphis Tigers vs. Temple (football)
events.blurb: Memphis closes its home schedule against Temple on Senior Day, with kickoff at 2:30 p.m. on ESPN.
events.blurbEs: Memphis cierra su temporada en casa contra Temple en el Senior Day; el partido empieza a las 2:30 p.m. y se transmite por ESPN.

events.title: Holiday Wonders at the Garden
events.blurb: The garden's holiday light walk opens for the season on Friday and runs select nights through Dec 30. Last entry is 7:30 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El recorrido de luces navideñas del jardín abre la temporada el viernes y sigue en noches seleccionadas hasta el 30 de diciembre. La última entrada es a las 7:30 p.m.
events.getThere: Free parking, entered through the Visitors Center; shuttle service with extra parking as needed.

events.title: The Enchanted Forest Festival of Trees
events.venue: Museum of Science & History – Pink Palace
events.blurb: A walk-through holiday display of decorated trees benefiting Le Bonheur Children's Hospital, with Santa photo packages available. Weekend time slots can sell out.
events.blurbEs: Una exhibición navideña de árboles decorados a beneficio del Le Bonheur Children's Hospital, con paquetes de fotos con Santa. Los horarios del fin de semana pueden agotarse.

events.title: Home Alone in Concert
events.blurb: The Memphis Symphony Orchestra plays John Williams' score live while Home Alone is shown on the big screen.
events.blurbEs: La Memphis Symphony Orchestra interpreta en vivo la música de John Williams mientras se proyecta Home Alone en pantalla grande.

events.title: Gabriel Iglesias: The 1976 Tour
events.blurb: Stand-up comedian Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias brings his 1976 Tour to FedExForum for one night.
events.blurbEs: El comediante Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias presenta su 1976 Tour en FedExForum por una sola noche.

events.title: Grizzlies vs. Lakers
events.blurb: The Grizzlies host the Los Angeles Lakers in a Sunday afternoon game.
events.blurbEs: Los Grizzlies reciben a Los Angeles Lakers en un partido el domingo por la tarde.

events.title: Starry Nights
events.addr: 6903 Great View Dr N, Memphis, TN 38134
events.blurb: Shelby Farms Park's drive-through holiday light show runs through Jan 3; Friday and Saturday are Afterglow nights with a walkable area at the end of the route. Timed tickets are sold online only, with no gate sales.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo de luces navideñas para recorrer en auto de Shelby Farms Park sigue hasta el 3 de enero; el viernes y el sábado son noches Afterglow, con una zona para caminar al final del recorrido. Las entradas con horario se venden solo en línea, no en la entrada.

events.title: Pat Patterson & Randy Parker Art Exhibition
events.blurb: Mixed-media landscapes by Pat Patterson and park watercolors by Randy Parker, shown in the garden's Grand Hallway. The show closes Nov 30.
events.blurbEs: Paisajes en técnica mixta de Pat Patterson y acuarelas de parques de Randy Parker, en el Grand Hallway del jardín. La muestra cierra el 30 de noviembre.

events.title: Main Street Holiday Lights
events.addr: S Main St between G.E. Patterson Ave and Butler Ave, Memphis, TN 38103
events.blurb: South Main Street is lit up for the holidays every night from 4 p.m. to midnight through January. Pair a stroll with dinner and shopping in the district.
events.blurbEs: South Main Street se ilumina para las fiestas todas las noches de 4 p.m. a medianoche hasta enero. Combina el paseo con una cena y compras en el distrito.

events.title: Santa's Wonderland
events.venue: Bass Pro Shops at the Pyramid
events.blurb: Free photos and a shareable video with Santa inside the Pyramid, plus crafts and a Christmas village, through Christmas Eve. Reserve a free time slot online; they fill up fast.
events.blurbEs: Fotos y un video gratis con Santa dentro de la Pirámide, además de manualidades y una villa navideña, hasta Nochebuena. Reserva un horario gratis en línea; se llenan rápido.
